description:
A cholera outbreak has been reported in Kenema District. As the HMIS Administrator, you need to configure a new Data Set in DHIS2 to track the outbreak. Log in to DHIS2 (admin/district) and navigate to the Maintenance app. Create a new Data Set with the following details:

1. Name: 'Cholera Outbreak Surveillance - Kenema'
2. Short name: 'Cholera Surv Kenema'
3. Period type: Weekly

After creating the basic details, you must:
4. Assign at least 3 existing data elements related to the outbreak (search for terms like 'Cholera', 'Diarrhoea', 'Dysentery', or 'ORS').
5. Assign the Data Set to the 'Kenema' district organisation unit (and/or its facilities).
6. Save the Data Set.
